With Plaid now powering bank connections inside ChatGPT, Sierra and Meta’s Muse, Robinson points to a telling stat: nearly two thirds of people connecting their accounts to AI assistants were new to Plaid-powered finance apps, a sign that consumers are getting serious about both AI and their finances.
